dialogues.jp: 「うーん……」
平日のテレビも、イマイチつまらないな。
dialogues.en: All the TV shows are boring on weekdays.
dialogues.text: All the TV shows are boring on weekdays.

dialogues.jp:
「天気もいいし、ぶらぶらと買い物にでも出か
　けるか」
dialogues.en: "It's such a nice day today. I might as well go shopping."
dialogues.text: "It's such a nice day today. I might as well go shopping."

dialogues.jp:
休みの間に遊べる、ゲームとか本でも物色しに
行こう。
dialogues.en:
I'm going to shop around for the games and books that I can
enjoy during this break.
dialogues.text:
I'm going to shop around for the games and books that I can
enjoy during this break.

dialogues.jp: 部屋に戻り、財布と家の鍵を持って外にでた。
dialogues.en:
I went back to my room to grab my wallet and keys, and went
out of the house.
dialogues.text:
I went back to my room to grab my wallet and keys, and went
out of the house.

dialogues.jp:
「平日の昼間だけあって、そんなにごった返し
　てないな」
dialogues.en:
"It's not that crowded... I guess it's because today's a
weekday."
dialogues.text:
"It's not that crowded... I guess it's because today's a
weekday."

dialogues.jp: ポケットに手をつっこんで、軽く辺りを見渡す。
dialogues.en: I stuck my hands in my pockets and looked around me.
dialogues.text: I stuck my hands in my pockets and looked around me.

dialogues.jp:
まだ休み初日ということもあるし、部活動やパー
ティーの準備にかかっている学生も多いからな。
dialogues.en:
Today's the first day of the break, and most students are at
school preparing for the party or participating in their
clubs' activates.
dialogues.text:
Today's the first day of the break, and most students are at
school preparing for the party or participating in their
clubs' activates.

dialogues.jp:
これが夕方になると、今度は夕飯の買い物客で
混みあうんだけど……。
dialogues.en:
Later, this place will be crowded with people shopping for
groceries......
dialogues.text:
Later, this place will be crowded with people shopping for
groceries......

dialogues.jp: 「ま、この時間からなら余裕か」
dialogues.en: "Well, I chose the right time to come here."
dialogues.text: "Well, I chose the right time to come here."

dialogues.jp:
空き空きのアーケードを進み、目的のショップ
を目指す。
dialogues.en:
I walked through the empty arcade and headed toward the
store.
dialogues.text:
I walked through the empty arcade and headed toward the
store.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、ブツも手に入れたし、帰るか」
dialogues.en:
"Well, now that I got what I wanted, I should head back
home."
dialogues.text:
"Well, now that I got what I wanted, I should head back
home."

dialogues.jp:
少し前に興味はあったが買い逃していたゲーム
の廉価版を手に入れ、ほくほくと家路を｛たど／辿｝ろう
とする。
dialogues.en:
I got the game that I've been interested in for the sale
price, and I decided to head back home.
dialogues.text:
I got the game that I've been interested in for the sale
price, and I decided to head back home.

dialogues.jp: 「おっ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 視線の先に、うちの制服が見える。
dialogues.en: I saw a student wearing my school's uniform ahead of me.
dialogues.text: I saw a student wearing my school's uniform ahead of me.

dialogues.jp:
（なんか、自分が休みの時に制服着てるヤツを
　見るのって、変な感じだな）
dialogues.en:
(It's kind of weird to see someone wearing uniform while I'm
off.)
dialogues.text:
(It's kind of weird to see someone wearing uniform while I'm
off.)

dialogues.jp:
そのままアーケードを進んでいくと、だんだん
とその学生の姿が近づいてくる。どうやら女の
子みたいだ。
dialogues.en:
As I continued to walk forward, I realized that student was
a girl.
dialogues.text:
As I continued to walk forward, I realized that student was
a girl.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩ッ」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
視線の先の女の子が萌先輩と分かり、進路を修
正する。
dialogues.en:
I realized that the girl was Moe-sempai, and I started to
walk towards her.
dialogues.text:
I realized that the girl was Moe-sempai, and I started to
walk towards her.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんです、こんな所で？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.jp: 今ごろ、学園で卒パの準備をしているはずだ。
dialogues.en:
She was supposed to be at school, preparing for the
graduation party.
dialogues.text:
She was supposed to be at school, preparing for the
graduation party.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「今度、卒業パーティーで使う道具を買いに来
　たんです」
dialogues.en:
"I came here to get something we need for the graduation
party."
dialogues.text:
"I came here to get something we need for the graduation
party."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、なるほど。もしかして先輩ひとりで？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see. Are you here alone?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see. Are you here alone?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: それはまた……思い切ったことを……。
dialogues.en: That's kind of risky......
dialogues.text: That's kind of risky......

dialogues.jp: （危険――心配だな。）
dialogues.en: (It's dangerous...... I'm worried.)
dialogues.text: (It's dangerous...... I'm worried.)

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、かったるいが……。
dialogues.en: It's kind of a pain, but......
dialogues.text: It's kind of a pain, but......

dialogues.jp: 「手伝いましょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Would you like me to help you?"
dialogues.text: "Would you like me to help you?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、悪いですから」
dialogues.en: "No thank you. I'd feel bad."
dialogues.text: "No thank you. I'd feel bad."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「気にしなくていいですよ」
dialogues.en: "You don't need to worry."
dialogues.text: "You don't need to worry."

dialogues.jp:
このまま別れたら、それこそ気になってしょう
がないだろうし。
dialogues.en: I'll be concerned if I leave her here alone.
dialogues.text: I'll be concerned if I leave her here alone.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……それじゃあ、お願いします」
dialogues.en: "Well...... Thank you then."
dialogues.text: "Well...... Thank you then."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。それで何を買うんです？」
dialogues.en: "No problem. What do you need to get?"
dialogues.text: "No problem. What do you need to get?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えーと、占いの道具なんです」
dialogues.en: "Well, I need some tools for fortune telling."
dialogues.text: "Well, I need some tools for fortune telling."

dialogues.jp: 聞き間違いだろうか。何故に音楽部で占い？
dialogues.en:
"Fortune telling? The music club's going to do fortune
telling?"
dialogues.text:
"Fortune telling? The music club's going to do fortune
telling?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……普通、演奏とかしません？」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I thought music clubs usually play music......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... I thought music clubs usually play music......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。演奏の人たちもいます」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Some people are going to play music."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Some people are going to play music."

dialogues.jp:
占いと演奏のふたつをするのか……部員に女子
が多いってのもあるのだろうが、深く追及する
のはやめよう。
dialogues.en:
They're going to play music and do fortune telling......
Perhaps it's because there are so many girls in the club,
but I'm not going to ask for any further details......
dialogues.text:
They're going to play music and do fortune telling......
Perhaps it's because there are so many girls in the club,
but I'm not going to ask for any further details......

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩は占いのほうなんですね」
dialogues.en: "So you're going to tell fortunes?"
dialogues.text: "So you're going to tell fortunes?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。まだそんなに上手くないので」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I'm not very good with the instruments yet......"
dialogues.text: "Yes. I'm not very good with the instruments yet......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、そのうち上手くなりますよ……じゃあ、
　行きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "I'm sure you'll improve...... Shall we go now?"
dialogues.text: "I'm sure you'll improve...... Shall we go now?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩とならんで、今度はふたりでアーケード
を歩く。
dialogues.en: We walked side by side through the arcade.
dialogues.text: We walked side by side through the arcade.

dialogues.jp: 「それでどんな物を？　タロットカードとか？」
dialogues.en:
"So what do you need to get? Do you need some Tarot cards or
something?"
dialogues.text:
"So what do you need to get? Do you need some Tarot cards or
something?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「カードやアクセサリー、それにローソクです」
dialogues.en: "I need some cards, accessories, and candles."
dialogues.text: "I need some cards, accessories, and candles."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あと、水晶なんかも欲しいです」
dialogues.en: "Oh, and I want a crystal ball too."
dialogues.text: "Oh, and I want a crystal ball too."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「なんか……本格的ですね。もしかして、専門
　店とかあるんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"It sounds like you want it fully-dressed...... Is there
supposed to be a store that specializes in those goods?"
dialogues.text:
"It sounds like you want it fully-dressed...... Is there
supposed to be a store that specializes in those goods?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい、そうみたいです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I heard there is."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I heard there is."

dialogues.jp: そんな店が存在するなんて、知らなかった。
dialogues.en: I didn't know they had a store like that.
dialogues.text: I didn't know they had a store like that.

dialogues.jp:
（ってことは、そういうのを普段、使ってる奴
　がいるってことか？）
dialogues.en:
(Does this mean that there are people out there who
regularly use those things?)
dialogues.text:
(Does this mean that there are people out there who
regularly use those things?)

dialogues.jp:
暗い部屋にローソクを灯し、水晶やカードを前
に日々、占いに興じている姿を想像する。
dialogues.en:
I imagined a person in a dark room with a candle, sitting in
front of the cards and a crystal ball.
dialogues.text:
I imagined a person in a dark room with a candle, sitting in
front of the cards and a crystal ball.

dialogues.jp: いかん。これも深く考えるのはよそう。
dialogues.en: I don't want to get myself too deep in this stuff......
dialogues.text: I don't want to get myself too deep in this stuff......

dialogues.jp: 「それで、そのお店はどこにあるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "So where's that store?"
dialogues.text: "So where's that store?"

dialogues.jp:
この商店街にそんなものがあるとは、ちっとも
知らなかった。
dialogues.en: I had no idea they had a store like that in this arcade.
dialogues.text: I had no idea they had a store like that in this arcade.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えーと、商店街にあるそうです」
dialogues.en: "Well, I heard that it's in the shopping arcade."
dialogues.text: "Well, I heard that it's in the shopping arcade."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……商店街のどこです？」
dialogues.en: "So...... where is it in the arcade?"
dialogues.text: "So...... where is it in the arcade?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はいっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: なぜ、そこでそんな表情を？
dialogues.en: Why's she looking at me like that?
dialogues.text: Why's she looking at me like that?

dialogues.jp: 「……とりあえず、人に｛き／訊｝いてみましょう」
dialogues.en: "......Well, I guess we have to start asking people."
dialogues.text: "......Well, I guess we have to start asking people."

dialogues.jp:
そんな店があることを知ってるヤツがいるのか
どうか分からないけど……。
dialogues.en:
I don't even know if there's anyone out here that knows
anything about a store like that......
dialogues.text:
I don't even know if there's anyone out here that knows
anything about a store like that......

dialogues.jp: 長い買い物になりそうだ。
dialogues.en: It's going to be a long shopping day.
dialogues.text: It's going to be a long shopping day.

dialogues.jp: ◆占い道具を求めて◆
dialogues.en: ◆Searching for fortune-telling equipment◆
dialogues.text: ◆Searching for fortune-telling equipment◆

dialogues.jp:
休み中にプレイするゲームを買うべく、商店街
へと出かけると、萌先輩と出会った。
dialogues.en:
I met Moe-sempai when I went to the shopping arcade in order
to get a game for myself to play during the break.
dialogues.text:
I met Moe-sempai when I went to the shopping arcade in order
to get a game for myself to play during the break.

dialogues.jp:
何でも、卒パでやる占いの道具を買いに来たら
しい。ちょっと要領の悪そうな萌先輩だ。俺は、
買い物付き合う事にした。
dialogues.en:
She told me that she was here to get some fortune-telling
equipment that she's going to use for the graduation party.
Knowing how slow she could be, I decided to help her with
shopping.
dialogues.text:
She told me that she was here to get some fortune-telling
equipment that she's going to use for the graduation party.
Knowing how slow she could be, I decided to help her with
shopping.
